# Review, pass 1 — secret-history-265-266 (§§265–266)

Checked: t against the packet (identical, 58 units, 412 words, ln/p correct); every morph's bracketed Ming gloss against the packet (all match); morph lemmas against known-forms and the published glossary; every grammatical label in every note; original → `l` word by word; `l` ↔ `i`; quote marks (t, l and i counts per unit, nesting); house renderings. All edits made by script (`t` and word order untouched).

## Changes

### Major
- U38 · i, n · Quote handling wrong. The first speech has already closed at `jabuja"` (U37), so `müṅke teṅgeri či mede"` is a second, outer quotation, not an inner one; `i` used single quotes and the note called it "inside the speech". `i` also added "calling out". Done: `i` now "Having said this, and saying “Eternal Heaven, you know it,”"; note rewritten (second quotation, double quotes; mede taken as statement or imperative, Ming 知 does not decide).
- U46 · i · `i` had the soldiers as the agents and rendered talaγ̇ulba (tala- + causative, "had plundered") as "destroyed". Done: "he sent soldiers and, as he had reckoned, had them plundered until all were destroyed."; note now says talaγ̇ulba is the causative, as in U41 (reference also corrected from U42).

### Moderate
- U7 · morph, n · keleleldüdkün split as kele- + -le- + -ldü- + -dkün, against the glossary (kelele-, keleledkün, keleleldüžü). Done: lemma kelele- + -ldü- + -dkün; note rewritten.
- U32 · morph, n · iredkün split ire- + -d- + -kün (and the note cited U8, wrong), against the glossary and against U7's -dkün. Done: ire- + -dkün; note cites U7.
- U13 · i · converb ičužu turned into a separate hortative sentence and morilad-že rendered "we shall mount" against `l` "let-us-mount" and the Ming 咱. Done: "Let us draw back; and when the Qahan’s body has cooled, let us mount again then.”"
- U20 · i · bolsu is an optative (Ming 做我, morph "let us be"); `i` said "will be". Done: "‘Let us, the Tangut people, be your right hand,’ you said."
- U23 · l, i · `l` "let-us-settle" contradicted the note, the morph and U25 ("let me", Ming 折證我); `i` added an unsupported "now". Done: `l` "let-me-settle"; `i` "Thinking, ‘I have another aim; afterwards let me settle with you,’".
- U37 · i · `i` turned jabuja ("let us go", as the note says) into "let us die". Done: "If we are to die, let us go on leaning on a great word.”"
- U40 · i, n, morph · `i` "pinned him in his stockade" was more specific than `l` ("having-made-stockade") and the note admits it is a guess; lemma qorγo- "guard" disagreed with the glossary's qorγo (stockade) + -la-. Done: `i` "had a stockade made on Alashai, and took Asha Gambu,"; morph qorγo + -la- + -γ̇ul- + -žu; note says the sense may be a siege.
- U41 · n, morph · note and morph claimed keis- "stem inferred from the Ming 刮", but the Ming here is 般直到; 刮 belongs to the published keisgen. Done: both reworded to cite keisgen; reference "U32" corrected to U31.
- U43 · i, n · abudqun is second person, `i` gave "let the soldiers take … what he has seized". Done: "take the Tanguts of every kind, you soldiers, each of you according to what you have seized and what you have got"; note says čeriġüd is read as addressed; note's Ming for eimün corrected (這般, not 這般每).
- U45 · i, n · "and against the Tanguts" implied a verb of marching; Taṅγ̇udud-i is the object of talaγ̇ulba (as the note says). Done: "and, as for the Tanguts who had taken to the mountain …"; note reference U32 → U31.

### Minor
- Title / part · "Chinggis’s last rewards": "last" is not in the text. Done: "rewards".
- about · "Burqan’s man Asha Gambu" is not in the text. Done: "Asha Gambu takes the taunt on himself and challenges them to fight at Alashai".
- U1 · morph lemma toγ̇a → toγa (glossary head).
- U4 · i · "came running past" ("running" added). Done: "came past".
- U8 · n · "tired after the fall" unsupported. Done: reworded, "my reading of 熱 hot".
- U14 · n · "aisai" in U26 → U25.
- U19 · i · "you spoke, and said" duplicated U20's "you said". Done: "when you spoke,".
- U22 · n · Ming for üge-ġer is 言語 敎, not 言語 裏 / 敎. Done.
- U24 · l · irgen-dür "-in" against "-to" elsewhere (Ming 行). Done: "-to".
- U25 · i · aisai is present ("is coming", morph); `i` "have come". Done: "I am coming".
- U27 · i · ese + past is "did not", not "never". Done.
- U28 · l · "Ašaγambu" against "Asha Gambu" elsewhere in `l`. Done.
- U30 · i · böġesü rendered "if that is so, and you Mongols … say", dropping ber ("even"). Done: "Even now, if you Mongols, practised in fighting, say …".
- U34 · n, morph · Ming for aγ̇urasun is 段疋 (not (段)子); "in modern Ningxia and Xiliang" was outside knowledge. Done. žoridqun morph -d- + -qun → whole -dqun.
- U39 · n · "three converbs" (there are four). Done: "These converbs".
- U42 · i · "manly" for erebin (note and `l`: "men"). Done: "the men and the best of the Tanguts".
- U44 · n, morph · cross-reference U1 → U0; the etymology "perhaps from čas(u)n 'snow'" is not from the Ming. Removed.
- U45 · morph · aγ̇ulalaγsad / daižiγsad had one lump "-γsad" while the note analyses -γsan + -d. Done: -γsan + -d.
- U47, U50, U57 · morph lemma Boγ̇orču → Boγorču (glossary head for the bare token).
- U50 · morph · -ürün "after a vowel stem" is wrong (ög- is consonant-final). Done: "linking vowel ü, then -rün".
- U52 · n · Ming for sačaγ̇u is 齊等 (not 一般); reference U44 → U43. Done.
- U53 · n, morph · jabudqun's "-d- of unknown force" against the glossary's whole -dqun (as abudqun). Done.
- U54 · n, morph · žasaγ̇uludqun -d- + -qun → -dqun; note's Ming "衣襟, 裙" (裙 is not in this packet) corrected; "the sense is" hedged.
- U55 · i, morph · "the Altan Qan" → "Altan Qan" (house); -ten gloss "possessive" → "possessive plural" (glossary, note).
- U57 · i, n, morph · "my own trusted" (min-u is just "my"); references U56 → U55 and U44 → U43; -ten gloss as at U55.

## Findings refused
- U21 · doubtful reading (whose counsel; "sent to ask you"). The note already says it cannot be settled; no better reading can be had from the form and the Ming alone. Left.
- U36 · `i` omits "that matter" (teli). The word is flagged uncertain in the note and the morph; leaving it out of `i` is defensible. Left.
- U4/U22 · lemma spelling daγ̇ari- against the glossary's daγari- for the token daγ̇arižu: the glossary itself uses both spellings (daγ̇ariba, daγ̇arin). Left.
- U24 / U0 · lemma mori vs morin vs morila- for morilažu / morilaba: the glossary uses all three. Left.
- U56 · `i` leaves -že ("indeed") unrendered; the house habit is to leave closing že unrendered. Left.
- U51 · "Kitad … here the Jin state": follows the glossary's existing sense and U55–56; the Ming here gives only 契丹, but the note does not overclaim. Left.
- U24 · "brought … into line" for žüg-tür oroγ̇ulžu: already declared as the drafter's rendering in the note. Left.
- U10, U11, U12 · "have built towns", "-qun participle or hortative": renderings match l and the Ming, with uncertainty stated. Left.

# Review, pass 2 — secret-history-265-266 (§§265–266)

Checked: units.json re-read whole after pass 1 (t, l, i, n, every morph) against the packet, the Ming glosses (every first-morph bracket equals the packet's gloss for its word: 412/412, no mismatch) and the published glossary; every one of the 58 gloss.json entries against its text, Ming gloss, the units' morphs/lemmas and the entry format; gloss keys against the tokens the build derives from `t` (273 distinct tokens, 58 novel; keys = novel tokens exactly, none missing, none unused, no known token duplicated; the four `__broaden__` keys are all known tokens present in `t`, each value = old entry whole + " · " + new reading); every known token's Ming gloss in this part against its glossary entry. Units pass-1 edits (-dkün lemmas, qorγo + -la- + -γ̇ul-, lemma renames, -γsan + -d) introduced no error in units.json; no unit edit was needed. All edits by script (`t` untouched).

## Changes (gloss.json only)

### Moderate
- toγ̇ulažu · head "toγ̇a" against unit lemma toγa (pass-1 rename) and the glossary head toγa. Done: "toγa — number …".
- keleleldüdkün · head "kele-" and "-le- verb-maker (uncertain)" against unit morph kelele- + -ldü- + -dkün and glossary kelele-/keleledkün. Done: rewritten as kelele- + -ldü- + -dkün.
- qorγolaγ̇ulžu · entry analysed qorγo- "to guard, fence in" + -la-; unit (pass 1) and glossary (qorγolaγsan) have qorγo "stockade" + -la- + -γ̇ul-. Done: head qorγo — stockade; "having a stockade made".
- žoridqun · "-d- plural 'you all' + -qun" against unit -dqun (whole, as glossary abudqun/jabudqun). Done.
- žasaγ̇uludqun · "-d- (force unknown), -qun" against unit -dqun. Done.
- aγ̇ulalaγsad, daižiγsad · "participle -γsad" against unit -γsan + -d. Done: -γsan + plural -d (n lost before -d).

### Minor

- nutugi · "accusative-like vowel" is unsupported; unit calls (i) a linking vowel. Done.
- časutu · "perhaps from čas(u)n 'snow'" (pass 1 removed this etymology from U44's note and it is not from the Ming). Done: removed; entry keeps Ming 雪山名.

## Findings refused
- Known tokens whose Ming differs only by variant character or near-synonym (temeġen 駱駝/駱馳, aγ̇urasun 段疋/(段)子, tabar 財物/物, sačaγ̇u 齊等/一般, itegelten 倚仗的每/倚附的, said 好每/好, abtuγai 要者/受者, qoina 在後/後, šiqan 靠着/挨,倚, bariγ̇ulužu 話着, ülidtele 直盡絕, uqažu 省着) : same sense, no broadening needed. Left.
- Known tokens with a sense already in the glossary under a "· also" (bi 有 "is", burqan 人名, qojar-a "to the two", irgen-dür "against", bürün "as for", že 罷, daγ̇u 把, kitad "Jin state"): covered. Left.
- U17 · `l` "So’oroqad-in" for dative-locative -ta (elsewhere "-to"): "in" suits Ming 地(名)行 "at"; consistent with the glossary's "at, in". Left.
- U51 · "not yet given" for ese ögüleġe: Ming 不曾 supports "yet". Left.
- U21 (reading doubtful), U36 (teli omitted from `i`) and the other pass-1 refusals stand; nothing new found against them.
- Lemma spelling differences known-vs-unit (morilaba mori vs morila-, daγ̇ari- vs daγari-, Žaγ̇ura žaγ̇ur): glossary itself mixes; left as in pass 1.
